confidence_notes: I ran two web searches: one for the RBA rate and one for Koh Samui prices. The RBA rate is the 18 November 2026 observation. The price search returned aggregated cost-of-living sites that disagree with each other. Beer, coffee, inexpensive meal and mid-range meal anchors come from those sites, adjusted for tourist-area pricing. No cocktail price was found, so the cocktail is estimated from the beer price, at about 3 times beer. Wine by the glass is estimated at about 3.5 times beer, because bottle prices are high on the island. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates, not checked against live listings, and they vary a lot by season and beach.
comparable_city_reasoning: Koh Samui is priced like other Thai island tourist destinations such as Phuket and Koh Phangan. It sits somewhat above mainland Thailand, with Bangkok as the baseline.
